diagnosis: The handler streams the generated audit log gzip archive identified solely by job_id. It never checks whether export_job.company_id == current_user.company_id, allowing an attacker who enumerates or guesses job IDs to download other enterprises' full audit archives.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/admin/audit-exports/job_exp_8849102/archive HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
